name: Practice Pulse
description: Patient flow, billing and coding, optical dispensing, staff management, technology ROI, telehealth, patient retention, compliance, and practice growth.

episodes.title: Patient Flow: From Check-In to Check-Out
episodes.description: Designing the optometric visit to minimize wait, maximize chair time, and keep staff productive.

episodes.title: The Front Desk: The First and Last Impression
episodes.description: Phone skills, greeting, and the insurance verification that prevents billing surprises.

episodes.title: Pre-Testing: The Technician Workflow
episodes.description: What to delegate, the order of tests, and the handoff that keeps the doctor on schedule.

episodes.title: Optical Dispensing: The Art of the Sell
episodes.description: Frame selection, lens recommendations, and the patient education that builds the sale and satisfaction.

episodes.title: Lens Materials: Index, Polycarbonate, and Trivex
episodes.description: Matching the material to the prescription, the lifestyle, and the safety demands of the patient.

episodes.title: Lens Designs: Single Vision, Progressive, and Office
episodes.description: The progressive corridor, the computer lens, and the occupational design that earns the premium.

episodes.title: Anti-Reflective Coatings: The Premium That Pays
episodes.description: The technology, the patient benefit conversation, and the bundle that lifts the average ticket.

episodes.title: Billing and Coding: The Eye Exam Codes
episodes.description: The 92004/92014 versus 9920x decision, the medical versus vision plan, and the documentation that supports it.

episodes.title: ICD-10 Coding: The Diagnosis That Drives the Claim
episodes.description: Common eye codes, the specificity requirement, and the linking that makes the claim payable.

episodes.title: Medical Eye Care: The Co-Management and Referral
episodes.description: The co-management contracts, the comanaged surgery billing, and the communication that sustains referrals.

episodes.title: Insurance Verification: The Pre-Visit Discipline
episodes.description: The benefits check, the patient responsibility estimate, and the conversation that prevents collections.

episodes.title: Staff Management: Hiring, Training, Retention
episodes.description: The job description, the onboarding, and the culture and compensation that retain good staff.

episodes.title: Staff Meetings: The Weekly Rhythm That Aligns
episodes.description: The agenda, the metrics review, and the patient story that keeps the team patient-centered.

episodes.title: Key Performance Indicators: The Numbers That Matter
episodes.description: Capture rate, revenue per exam, recall rate — the dashboard that diagnoses the practice.

episodes.title: Recall and Reactivation: The Patients Who Drifted
episodes.description: The recall system, the multi-channel approach, and the reactivation campaign that fills the schedule.
